assets.title: SW-2 · The rise · Flow prototype
assets.note: First Flow SW-2 prototype received and technically measured: eight seconds, 1280 × 720, 24 fps. Sampled review found an open mouth with visible teeth despite the closed-mouth instruction, plus a non-silent audio track despite the silent-output prompt. Exact detail continuity, camera lock and worm movement remain to be assessed. Normal-speed playback and listening are not recorded. No human or production acceptance is recorded.

assets.title: Signal · Flow prototype · performance revision requested
assets.note: First Signal Flow prototype received and technically measured: eight seconds, 1280 × 720, 24 fps. Ziggy liked the scene and requested more character performance: a concerned look offscreen and upward to the right, communicating with teammates. The recorded feedback leaves the actor/screen-side convention for Claude to make explicit. The measured audio track is near-silent; no listening review is claimed. The later take-two intake pins the finished writer card. The positive first-take scene feedback is not inherited by take two. No stars, Keep decision, whole-look approval or production acceptance is inferred.

assets.title: Signal · take two · acting direction review pending
assets.note: Second Signal Flow prototype received and technically measured: eight seconds, 1280 × 720, 24 fps. Sampled review found the gaze turning viewer-right instead of the authored upward viewer-left teammate eyeline, later returning toward the lens; the palm motion is oversized and central, and the mouth reopens with visible teeth. Substantial audio is present despite the silent prompt. Added motion is not a verified performance fix. Normal-speed playback, listening and Claude review of these measured mismatches remain pending. Take-one positive feedback does not approve this take; no stars, Keep or production acceptance is recorded. Both takes use the same exact starting image; take two is not a continuation of the take-one video.
